mu_name_from: MuMain loads boot indexes 10 to 14 from BootElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 152), so index 10 is BootElf01, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Vine Boots. mu.db agrees: code 5642, group 11 index 10, Player/BootElf01.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's own first set, and the one set of the three that nobody sells: no shelf in Lorencia carries Vine, so this is a drop and a thing to look at. It is here because the Armour select had a single glove under her name and a set of one piece is a set you cannot see.
profile_from: Not armour, whose default is plate_steel: nothing in this set is a forged plate. See profiles/soft_armour.json, which exists for these three sets.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateBoots(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, walkSpeed, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). Slot 6, so the group is 11.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.walk_speed_note: Nought. The elf's boots carry no walk bonus where the Knight's Leather Boots carry twelve, which is the row's own asymmetry and is recorded rather than smoothed.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. Sixty agility beside thirty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/boots_04c.OZJ (64x64), boots_04b.ozt (32x32) and hide.jpg, from MuMain. The .bmd names boots_04c.jpg, boots_04b.tga and hide.jpg; 120 of the 128 triangles are on the first, 4 on the fins and 4 on hide.
sheet_note: boots_04c is the boot from two sides, dark hide with the vine scroll worked up the shin and a studded cuff. Mean (71, 48, 34) at chroma 38. boots_04b is the pair of gilt fins that stand off the calf on two crossed quads, and it is the same sheet the Pad Boots wear - the two sets share the ornament and nothing else.
material_note: Four islands. Islands 2 and 3 are 62 each - boots_04c's 120 and hide's caps, the two boots - and take leather: dark hide with the vine scroll raised in the same brown, as on the bodice and the circlet. Islands 0 and 1 are two triangles each, which is boots_04b's 4: the gilt fins on crossed quads. brass, and the same brass the Pad Boots take, because it is the same sheet - MU shares that one ornament between the wizard's set and the elf's and shares nothing else.
